    Findings

    These findings use all years and all districts.

    • 11,186 of 11,186 unique RERA filings are started, active projects (100.0%). 269 repeated rows are removed.
    • Ranga Reddy leads with 3,500 projects, 31.3% of mapped projects.
    • The top three districts hold 65.0% of mapped projects: Ranga Reddy, Medchal-Malkajgiri, Sangareddy.
    • The four Hyderabad metro districts hold 70.2% of mapped projects.
    • 2,389 projects (21.4%) complete in 2025, the peak completion year.
    • 3,834 projects (34.3%) complete after 2026.
    • 6,472 active projects (57.9%) have a completion date before the reference date.
    • 86.0% of projects with a building count have one approved building. The RERA unit fields count buildings, not flats.
    • 6,119 projects (54.7%) report a flat count: 603,476 flats, median 20 for each project.
    • Residential is the largest project type on the RERA portal: 7,112 of 11,455 listings (62.1%). The portal totals include the repeated rows.
    • 100.0% of projects map to a district. 1 project needs review.
